findings:
  - id: "MVP-P1-001"
    severity: P1
    file: "architecture/checks/feature-module-standard-profile.mjs"
    line: "127-174"
    claim: "The first private production source is admitted only after the required product-owner start decision."
    evidence: >-
      Accepted ADR-0015 requires a governed start record before the first
      production source (docs/decisions/0015...md:108-113), but the admission
      function has no start-record input or validation. The exact profile is
      still pre-production, and the report acknowledges the missing record at
      research/implementation-readiness/report.md:144-152. This is a real
      admission-gate defect, not evidence that the research branch itself has
      production scope.
    requiredAction: >-
      Define a governed start-record format bound to the intended private
      package/source identity and make admission and governance checks reject
      the first production source when it is absent.
    confidence: 0.99
  - id: "MVP-P1-002"
    severity: P1
    file: "research/implementation-readiness/report.md"
    line: "124-163, 517-533"
    claim: "The repository has an executable MVP semantic compiler subject and gate."
    evidence: >-
      The exact tree has no packages/core, compiler implementation, packed
      subject, or named Core gate. package.json:17-44 contains only contract,
      fixture/oracle, governance, and documentation checks. The profile remains
      not-claimed (architecture/feature-module-standard-profile.json:71-92),
      and the report explicitly classifies Phase 3 as no-go and the current
      evidence as static/oracle-only. This is a missing proof, not a defect in
      the intentionally research-only branch.
    requiredAction: >-
      After the owner-start condition, implement the smallest private
      normalized-value Core subject and an independent named gate covering the
      accepted cardinality, graph, diagnostic, determinism, immutability, and
      digest vectors. Keep it private and non-publishable.
    confidence: 0.99
  - id: "MVP-P1-003"
    severity: P1
    file: "docs/architecture/self-composition-implementation-guide.md"
    line: "306-330, 607-638"
    claim: "The proposed self-composition layout has one authoritative dependency mechanism."
    evidence: >-
      Accepted ADR-0008 limits composed consumers to type-only ports and curated
      internal surfaces (docs/decisions/0008...md:198-203), while the guide
      permits runtime value imports of provider identity constants and calls
      every own-graph edge the second composition mechanism. The exception is
      explicitly marked proposed and no source-dependency policy or production
      graph exists in the exact tree. This is an ownership/authority ambiguity
      that blocks structural and self-composition claims, not a reason to add a
      framework.
    requiredAction: >-
      Resolve the identity-constant exception through accepted authority and a
      mechanically enforced source policy, or remove the value imports. Do not
      silently introduce a second static dependency mechanism or central
      registry.
    confidence: 0.97
  - id: "MVP-P2-001"
    severity: P2
    file: "docs/decisions/0007-require-executable-v1-conformance-amendments.md"
    line: "427-450"
    claim: "The retained API/DX measurements can guide MVP API or Pure-DI selection."
    evidence: >-
      ADR-0007 fixes required()/optional() with no arguments, many({min,max})
      with order "profile", no cloning/freezing, and defineModule(x) identity.
      Retained fixtures use incompatible shapes or behavior: b1 takes arguments
      and clones (b1/fixture.ts:4-7), b2-v freezes and accepts a factory
      (b2-v/fixture.ts:3-6), b4-v uses positional many and localeCompare
      (b4-v/src/api.ts:5-13), and b5 also uses a non-authoritative shape and
      locale-aware ordering (b5/api.ts:3-8). Their scenario outcomes are
      synthetic or fixture-local, as documented at report.md:284-309.
    requiredAction: >-
      Keep all current LOC, inference, and scenario numbers explicitly
      exploratory. Add one exact-shape private fixture and a real compiler
      handoff before using them for API or MVP complexity decisions.
    confidence: 1.0
  - id: "MVP-P2-002"
    severity: P2
    file: "docs/decisions/0008-bounded-internal-engine-self-composition.md"
    line: "364-388"
    claim: "The static emitter, two roots, and self-composition cost are objectively bounded."
    evidence: >-
      ADR-0008 states LOC, gate-time, runtime-overhead, and tarball-growth
      thresholds, but provides no accepted LOC denominator, baseline artifact,
      benchmark command, runtime/hardware specification, warm-up, sampling, or
      statistical method. package.json:17-44 has no measurement gate. The
      detailed protocol appears only in proposed ADR-0011, while the report
      correctly calls current measurements directional and says complexity
      budgets have no executable proof (report.md:450-464, 497-513).
    requiredAction: >-
      Define and accept a reproducible checkpoint-A measurement protocol,
      including scope, baseline, commands, runtime, samples, and archive-size
      calculation. Treat the thresholds as advisory until then and do not use
      them to justify expanding the privileged kernel.
    confidence: 0.99
